slide.caption: The experience begins in the 1852 Naples Observatory, inviting users to discover the Psyche asteroid through an interactive, period-accurate telescope.
The Chrysalis: Exploring the mythological parallels between the asteroid's dormant state as a planetesimal core and the chrysalis from Greek lore.
Bridging eras by transitioning from historical astronomical observation to the modern-day launch of the 2023 Psyche spacecraft.
The Butterfly: Highlighting the spacecraft's design, where its expansive solar panels symbolize butterfly wings representing the Psyche, "breath of life."
The Mythos: Uniting the scientific mission with the narrative of the Goddess Psyche, framing the exploration of the asteroid as the realization of her immortality.
Proposed UI design for the initial launch page, establishing the thematic tone and narrative context of the experience.
UI mockup of the Asteroid Mythos Phase, showcasing the gamified AR telescope interactions designed for discovering Psyche-16.
UI mockup of the transitional phase, bridging the historical discovery phase and the modern spacecraft mission.
Settings menu mockup highlighting customizable accessibility controls to ensure inclusive engagement for all users.
UI design mockup of the interactive dialog components used to seamlessly deliver mythological lore and scientific data.
Asset creation process for the Psyche and Persephone narrative sequence.
Integration of the early Psyche 3D model prototype into the Skybox environment.
Initial user interface prototype for the help and onboarding screen.
Contextual UI pop-ups designed to enhance in-world lore and narrative delivery.
Early prototyping and layout design for the AMP lore system.
Implementation of the opening scene, establishing the narrative context for the discovery of Psyche.
Full integration of the 3D Psyche asteroid model into the core experience.
Refined Skybox exploration sequence, featuring upgraded visuals and a dynamic blur mechanic to obscure undiscovered elements.

Redesigned launch page UI incorporating the Psyche brand color palette and an optimized layout to reduce text density.
